questions.question: Select the best express synonym of the highlighted word. The old manuscript was written in an obscure dialect that few scholars today can understand.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the best express synonym of the highlighted word.

The old manuscript was written in an obscure dialect that few scholars today can understand.
questions.solution: C) Obscure (adjective) – Unclear, hidden, unknown, vague, ambiguous अस्पष्ट

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. A woman having more than one husband at the same time
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A woman having more than one husband at the same time
questions.solution: C) Polyandry (noun) – A woman having more than one husband at the same time. बहुपतित्व

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence. King Zheng is known to lead an army of a million armoured soldiers, a thousand chariots and ten thousand horses in his misssion to conquer the neighbouring kingdoms
questions.questionHtml:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

King Zheng is known to lead an army of a million armoured soldiers, a thousand chariots and ten thousand horses in his misssion to conquer the neighbouring kingdoms
questions.solution: C) The correct spelling of ‘Misssion’ is ‘Mission’ which means “an important assignment carried out for political, religious, or commercial purposes” मिशन, अभियान.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. I find that students nowadays are not interested in _________ letters by hand
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I find that students nowadays are not interested in _________ letters by hand
questions.solution: D) Writing' का use होगा क्योंकि "writing" का अर्थ होता है लिखना। sentence में mention किया गया है कि आजकल के छात्र हाथ से पत्र लिखने में रुचि नहीं रखते, इसलिए 'writing' यहाँ सही है। जबकि 'righting' का अर्थ है सही करना, 'rioting' का अर्थ है दंगा करना, और 'rating' का अर्थ है मूल्यांकन करना, जो इस context में सही नहीं है।

questions.question: Select the option that rectifies the spelling of the underlined word in the given sentence. It was a privvilege to receive the award from the President.

It was a privvilege to receive the award from the President.
questions.solution: D) The correct spelling of ‘privvilege’ is ‘privilege’ which means “a special right, advantage, or immunity granted or available only to a particular person or group” विशेष अधिकार.

questions.question: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. The auditions for India's first ever/reality based pop band hunt is/going on in full swing/with numerous entries which came in.
questions.questionHtml:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The auditions for India's first ever/reality based pop band hunt is/going on in full swing/with numerous entries which came in.

options.text: The auditions for India's first ever
options.html: The auditions for India's first ever

options.text: reality based pop band hunt is
options.html: reality based pop band hunt is
going on in full swing

options.text: with numerous entries which came in.
options.html: with numerous entries which came in.

questions.solution: B) 'are' will be used instead of 'is' because the subject 'auditions' of the sentence is plural for which Plural Verb will be used.

questions.question: The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer A property dealer was/shoot dead by four unidentified jacket-clad men/while taking a morning walk/in the park.
questions.questionHtml:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer

A property dealer was/shoot dead by four unidentified jacket-clad men/while taking a morning walk/in the park.

options.html: A property dealer was

options.text: shoot dead by four unidentified jacket-clad men
options.html: shoot dead by four unidentified jacket-clad men
while taking a morning walk

questions.solution: B) 'shot' will be used instead of 'shoot' because in Passive Voice V3 is used with the verb 'Be' and 'shoot' is used as V2 and V3 as 'shot'.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. The housing loan taken by Ramesh effected his daily expenses adversely.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The housing loan taken by Ramesh effected his daily expenses adversely.
questions.solution: D) 'by Ramesh effected' के बदले 'by Ramesh affected' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'effected' का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ को लागू करना या उसका परिणाम निकालना, जबकि यहां पर loan ने Ramesh के daily expenses को नकारात्मक रूप से प्रभावित किया है। इसलिए 'affected' का उपयोग सही है, जो किसी चीज़ पर प्रभाव डालने का संकेत देता है; जैसे— The housing loan taken by Ramesh affected his daily expenses adversely.

questions.question: Select the best express synonym of the highlighted word. We need to bolster our arguments with solid evidence to win the case.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the best express synonym of the highlighted word.

We need to bolster our arguments with solid evidence to win the case.
questions.solution: B) Bolster (verb) – Support, strengthen, reinforce, boost, fortify मजबूत करना

questions.question: Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select No improvement required. Although uncountable files stack up on the tables of government officials, they prefer doing their work at a more leisure pace
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select No improvement required.

Although uncountable files stack up on the tables of government officials, they prefer doing their work at a more leisure pace

options.html: at a more leisurely paced
at a more leisurely pace
at a more leisure paced

questions.solution: B) 'at a more leisure pace' के बदले 'at a more leisurely pace' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'leisure' एक noun है जबकि यहां adjective की जरूरत है जो 'pace' (noun) का वर्णन कर सके। 'Leisurely' एक adjective और adverb दोनों रूप में प्रयोग हो सकता है और यहां इसे adjective की तरह प्रयोग किया गया है। अतः 'at a more leisurely pace' सही विकल्प होगा; जैसे— Although uncountable files stack up on the tables of government officials, they prefer doing their work at a more leisurely pace.

questions.question: Comprehension: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank. Development in Bhopalaram village, situated in the Lunkaransar block of Bikaner, Rajasthan, has come to a halt due to the lack of proper roads. The absence of a _____1_____ road is a significant challenge for the nearly two thousand residents in the village. According to 47-year-old resident Baluram Jat, the main road connecting the village to the block headquarters was constructed around eight years ago and has not been maintained _____2______, rendering it _____3_____.The road's ______4_____ condition has made it challenging even for families to transport patients to the hospital. During Vimla's childbirth, the ambulance broke down due to the damaged road, forcing the family to arrange a private vehicle to reach the hospital. Vimla, a 28-year-old young woman from the village, noted that her condition worsened due to the road's large potholes. She highlighted that many pregnant women in the village prefer going to their parental homes for childbirth due to these challenges. ______5______, for those unable to do so, the journey to the hospital becomes exceedingly difficult. Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
